description: This file defines the MemorySessionStorage class implementing SessionStorageInterface for in-memory session storage in a web framework, including methods for session management, registration of session bags, and metadata handling.

classes.name: MemorySessionStorage
classes.description: A class for managing session data stored in memory, implementing the SessionStorageInterface.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the session, returns true indicating success.

methods.name: isStarted
methods.description: Checks if the session has been started, always returns true.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the session ID, here a placeholder empty string.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the session ID, placeholder implementation.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the session name, placeholder implementation.

methods.name: regenerate
methods.description: Regenerates the session ID, optionally destroying existing data.

methods.name: getBag
methods.description: Retrieves a session bag by name, throws exception if not found.

methods.name: getMetadataBag
methods.description: Returns the metadata bag associated with the session storage.
